summary: Pair 4 occupies the Day 4 slot exactly: decoding CVC words in connected sentences, transferring Day 3 blending to print at sentence level. Heart words (the, on, a) are introduced as quick-read items distinct from CVC decoding. Materials remain everyday only: sentence strips written in marker, pencil pointer, sticky notes for the stretch task. The expanded_walkthrough names the freeze trap (child stops at unknown words) — a metacognitive Grade-1 gap, not a phonics gap — and recovery moves teach the keep-going behaviour. Worksheet's three parts each practise a named success criterion: Part 1 read-and-circle, Part 2 sentence-picture match, Part 3 fill-in-the-blank with word bank. Pair 4 cleared to scale to pair 5.
